morning.tone: Authority and credibility. Teach something real. Build trust. CTA is secondary to value.

afternoon.tone: Warm and helpful. Gently acknowledge the common mid-afternoon energy dip (never a diagnosis of the reader), then offer the product as a supportive resource. Lead with value; include product, price, and full URL with a friendly, confident call to action. Never pressure or hype.

evening.tone: Warm and aspirational. Encourage the reader and share what the resource genuinely offers. Present it as good value with a clear, friendly call to action; include product, price, and full URL. Confident and inviting, never hype or pressure.

night.tone: The 10 PM last-call. Urgency plus social proof — a testimonial-style result or 'women/men are seeing this' framing, reflective before-bed tone, last-chance-today energy. The product is the proven solution. Specific price, full URL on their own lines. Confident, warm, never hype.
